name: Central Textiles Inc
old_description: Central Textiles is an integrated textile producer that has been in operation in Central, SC since 1984 when the current owners purchased an old, existing textile mill and began a complete modernization to make it a state of the art manufacturing facility able to compete in today’s global marketplace. The upgrades have been a continuing, ongoing process with the installation of the latest generation in weaving technology.
about:
Central Textiles Inc operates in Central, South Carolina, where the current owners acquired an existing textile mill in 1984 and embarked on a comprehensive modernization program to create a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility.

The company runs a fully integrated textile operation encompassing spinning, weaving, finishing, and coating and laminating. Its production line includes state-of-the-art air-jet weaving, warping, slashing, carding, and fiber-opening equipment, enabling the manufacture of commercial, industrial, and apparel fabrics as well as technical and industrial textiles.

Central Textiles serves customers in the apparel, commercial, and industrial sectors, supplying fabrics for technical and industrial applications. Finished-goods inquiries are directed to its affiliated company, Cotswold Industries, which handles fabric finishing to customer specifications.

The company emphasizes continuous investment in technology, lean management, and just-in-time processes to reduce waste and cost, positioning itself as a flexible, innovative partner focused on quality, cost efficiency, and adaptability.
